generate_text: generate text outputs from prompts or input ids using sampling parameters and optional image data
flush_engine_cache: flush the engine cache to free GPU memory and reset internal state
update_model_weights: update model weights in-place from a list of named tensors without restarting the engine
load_lora_adapter: load a LoRA adapter by name and path into the running engine without relaunching
release_gpu_memory: release GPU memory occupation temporarily and resume it later for memory-constrained workloads
